name: Deciding records reach the pass
purpose: Measures whether a pass of AI that considers one solution is given the records its verdict depends on, the ones held only in the network (a recorded result, a finding, the parent, the children's coherence, a dependency's interface) included, within a size budget, closest first; and, at the paid stages, whether such a pass reaches the verdict the records support where a pass without them does not. Knowledge cases ask whether the items a situation bears on reach the pass while contradicted, expired and unrelated ones do not.
record: Cases passed out of cases run for each arm on the same cases, one row per run in the results log pinned to the commit and the case hash; the balanced score with [balance.solution_consideration].
disadvantages: The free stage checks that the deciding record is in the prompt, not that a model uses it; the cases are a synthetic repository shaped like one real incident plus this repository's own records. The knowledge cases are five, on one synthetic solution, and the reference retriever's cut was set while writing them, so they show the mechanism, not a measured edge; held-out knowledge cases from real repositories are the next stage.
cascading_conditionals: free [sample=full | real=no | gate=all-pass | when=the prompt of each case is assembled from the synthetic repository and this repository's records: seconds, no model] > one [sample=sample:1 | real=yes | gate=competitive | when=a person approved one model call per arm: a cheap model judges the reputed candidate of the synthetic repository given the network prompt and given the record alone, and passes when only the first cites the measured loss; and on the knowledge cases, a pass given the knowledge the situation chose against one given every item and one given none] > sample [sample=sample:10 | real=yes | when=ten network-only cases from real repositories, with an approved budget]
command: esoi run solution_consideration --impl network_tiered; esoi run solution_consideration --impl definition_only; esoi run solution_consideration --impl all_knowledge; esoi run solution_consideration --impl no_knowledge; esoi run consideration_verdicts --impl network_prompt_model; esoi run consideration_verdicts --impl record_alone_model
